messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — we need to secure a short term capacity commitment in europe-west4 to bootstrap a new inference cluster (bring-up window Apr 9-16). Target: 40 x A100 (a2-highgpu-1g) with 4TB ephemeral SSDs for model cache. Need quota + network validation window. Who can own the quota ticket and the handoff doc?

Alex: Can you give the exact instance sku, expected pod density per GPU and a rough cost delta? Also which project & billing?

Maria: Instance: a2-highgpu-1g (A100 40GB). We plan ~8 pods per GPU with our perf-tuned runtime. Peak expected: ~2000 qps, ~120M tokens/day. Cost rough: ~$25k/week GPU compute (ballpark). Project: redwood-eu-inference-prod, billing: infra-commits.

Ben: I can file the quota request. Prefer the start to be 2025-04-09 00:00 UTC so we can run network + smoke tests day before. Will we need a reserved commitment or temporary quota?

Maria: Start with temporary quota + reservation hold if provider allows. If things look steady, we'll convert to a month reserve. Also we need ephemeral SSDs (4TB) and a /24 for peering.

Priya: For networking, we need a dedicated test window to run iperf3, MTU checks, and validate NAT/egress rules. Proposed window: Apr 8 22:00-23:30 UTC. I can run the tests if infra approves.

Sam: Add me for network tests. Also request burst buffer / local-ssd IOPS for model cache — 4TB total across nodes. I'll include the IO profile.

Jo: FYI finance: this is likely to convert to a reserved commit after the validation week. @finance-team please watch the billing impact.

fin-bot: Noted. Please include cost center and PO number in the quota request, or we will block approval.

Maria: Draft quota request snippet I'm about to submit:

```
resource: GPUs
region: europe-west4
sku: a2-highgpu-1g
quantity: 40
start: 2025-04-09T00:00Z
end: 2025-04-17T00:00Z
purpose: cluster bootstrap + validation (inference)
project: redwood-eu-inference-prod
billing: infra-commits
contact: maria@redwood.com
tests: iperf3, latency SLO smoke, routing validation
fallback: a10g-spot pool + quantized model image
```

Alex: Add a fallback plan in the ticket: lower-memory instances (a10g) + quantized model artifacts so we can keep serving at reduced throughput if A100s are delayed. Also add canary rollout plan (start with 4 GPUs at 5% traffic).

Ben: Submitted ticket INC-2025-784 with the provider and requested temporary quota while approval processes. I created a soft-hold reservation pending payment verification.

Priya: Network runbook snippet for validation (to copy into confluence):

```
1) verify VPC peering routes: `gcloud compute routes list --filter="network:peered"`
2) spin iperf3 server on test-n1, client on test-n2: `iperf3 -s` / `iperf3 -c <ip> -P 8 -t 60`
3) check MTU: `ping -M do -s 8972 <ip>` (confirm no fragmentation)
4) validate path MTU across peering and confirm no TCP segmentation in route
5) smoke HTTP latency tests against canary service (10k reqs, p99 target <150ms)
```

Sam: I'll run the iperf3 + MTU checks Apr 8 22:00 UTC and post logs here. Who should I notify on failure?

Maria: Ping SRE oncall and Priya. If any test fails, we pause reservation conversion and fall back to regional hosted pool. Also need a clear rollback: scale down to 10 GPUs and route traffic to hosted pool.

Jo: Canary plan suggestion: start with 4 GPUs, route 5% traffic, ramp 5-10% every 30m until 50% then reassess. Also add an automated fallback trigger: if p95 latency >300ms for 3 consecutive minutes, route traffic to hosted pool.

Alex: Added the canary details to the ticket and the provider reservation notes. Also adding automation hook for fallback routing.

Ben: Cloud provider approved temporary quota and released the soft hold pending payment token. Sent billing verification request.

finance: Payment token added and verified. Ben — reservation converted to active at 2025-04-08 18:30 UTC.

Maria: Awesome — I'll update the confluence handoff doc with the final test checklist, canary plan, scaling policies and failure modes: https://confluence.redwood.com/infra/eu-west4-bootstrap. Will post final validation logs here after the tests. Thanks everyone! :tada:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2025-04-08 21:50 UTC — network validation run (assigned: Sam, Priya).
